title: A mutate_sweep mutant's anchor matches once, and the sweep's anchor pre-check reads ambiguous anchors too
why: In janitor/mutate_sweep.py the mutant "stale lock: a lock reason of another form counts as stale" (~1177) matches janitor/sweep.py twice, at :439 and :480 (note sweep-anchor-first-match), and the sweep's pre-check (~1584) checks only that an anchor is present, never that it matches once, so the mutant hits the first match, which may not be the site it means (lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, session_013NEJKzzx35nAWSwPacHRXt, 04:27 CST Nov 8; coordinator 04:26 CST).
note: Fix: point that mutant's anchor at stale_agent_lock_verdict; move mutate_sweep's stale-only pre-check (~1584) onto mutate_shared.find_anchor; add it to the new lint/check_mutant_anchors.py. Follows step lane-lint-mutant-anchors and retires note sweep-anchor-first-match. Red case first: the ambiguous anchor passes the sweep pre-check today; control: a unique anchor passes. Lane session_013NEJKzzx35nAWSwPacHRXt. The coordinator named it mutate-sweep-anchor-first-match; the lane first named it sweep-mutant-anchor-check, which triage kept. Queue fix. Filed 04:30 CST Nov 8.
